findings.title: Child data collected without parental consent flow
findings.evidence: Date of birth / age is collected (a form asks for 'dob'), but no parent or guardian consent flow exists anywhere, so under-18s are processed without a parent's consent [only a date of birth was found, nothing shows minors use the app; verify manually: it may be collected from adults only]

lines: <input type="date" class="form-control" id="dob" name="dob" value="{{dob}}" placeholder="Enter date of birth">

law.requirement: Verifiable consent of the parent before processing a child's personal data.

findings.severity_reason: Rs 200 crore cap; affects a protected group.
findings.fix: Gate under-18 sign-ups behind verified parental consent (Rule 10 methods).

law.requirement: Access control and appropriate technical and organisational measures.

findings.severity_reason: Raises the chance and impact of a breach of stored personal data.

findings.title: No breach notification mechanism
findings.evidence: Personal data is held (e.g. table users) but nothing in the project handles a breach: no incident module, no user or Board notification, no alert hook; verify manually: the breach process may be run outside the code

law.requirement: Inform affected users without delay; send the Board a detailed report within 72 hours.

findings.severity_reason: Process often lives outside code; absence is a signal, not proof.
findings.fix: Add an incident module that can notify affected users and generate the Board report.

findings.title: No correction or erasure endpoint
findings.evidence: No route lets users erase (DELETE /me or /account) their own data (personal data is held, e.g. table users)

law.requirement: Right to correction, completion, updating and erasure.

penalty.provision: any other provision of the Act or Rules

findings.severity_reason: Users cannot exercise a statutory right.
findings.fix: Add PATCH /me and an erasure request endpoint.

findings.title: Personal data collected without a notice of data and purpose
findings.evidence: <form role="form" method="post" action="/profile"> [the form asks for address, bank_account, bank_routing, dob, full_name, ssn but the page shows no notice of what is collected and why; verify manually: the notice may be in a modal or an earlier step]

lines: <input type="text" class="form-control" id="firstName" name="firstName" value="{{firstNameSafeString}}" placeholder="Enter first name">

law.requirement: Notice must give an itemised description of the personal data and the specified purpose.

penalty.provision: any other provision of the Act or Rules

findings.severity_reason: Notice is a precondition for valid consent; impact is on transparency, not direct exposure.
findings.fix: Show an itemised notice (data fields + purpose) before or with the consent request.
